center_dispatch.evidence_boundary: The committed singleton file was reread from main. Its RAE_META JSON parses, has packet_id, exact heading-derived title, folder-derived model_runtime domain, literal OPEN status, literal origin_actor, and only source_refs present in the packet body. A full repository checkout was unavailable through the private-repo connector boundary, so the repository-wide materializer command itself is not claimed as executed.

grf.observed_anchor: The center opened 16 folder-partitioned RAE_META lanes because 75/324 packets lacked RAE_META; model_runtime was a one-file lane and remained unannotated when claimed.
grf.hypothesis: Adding a packet-self-derived RAE_META header to the model_runtime singleton closes that lane without changing packet claims.
grf.strongest_counterhypothesis: A structurally green RAE_META header can still carry semantically transplanted metadata, so materializer acceptance alone does not prove derivability/provenance correctness.
grf.discriminator: Validate both structural acceptance and literal derivability of every emitted field from the packet/folder.

go_oob_experiment.baseline: Correct packet_id/title/model_runtime domain metadata parsed with no structural error.
go_oob_experiment.counterworld: The same packet_id with a Frank packet title and frank domain also parsed with no structural error.
go_oob_experiment.interpretation: tools/materialize_micro_packets.py is a structural materializer gate, not a semantic provenance validator. A green materializer result must not be promoted to proof that title/domain/source metadata is packet-derived.
go_oob_experiment.rollback: No validator or canonical-state change was made from this experiment.

architecture_delta.affected_component: research knowledge materialization/provenance boundary feeding FRANK_V0_1
architecture_delta.delta: Keep materializer completion scoped to structural materialization; if semantic RAE_META correctness becomes a release-relevant invariant, add a separate derivability/provenance validator rather than overloading the materializer.
architecture_delta.strongest_counterargument: The dispatch hard rule plus human/worker review may be sufficient for this derived-memory backfill, and a semantic validator could add complexity without current release value.
architecture_delta.next_falsifier: Measure whether existing provenance/schema tooling already rejects a deliberately domain/title-transplanted RAE_META packet before adding any new validator.
architecture_delta.rollback: No production or Harness behavior changed.

negative_results_preserved: A structurally accepted RAE_META block can be semantically wrong.
